candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi prefixes, roots, and syllabic components related to foundational words and expressions.
This vector represents common character subwords, syllables, or roots found in Devanagari script for languages like Hindi.
This vector activates on fragments and characters of Hindi text.
This vector fires on Devanagari halant conjuncts and unrelated multilingual artifacts appearing as noisy tokenization anomalies.
This vector activates on common sub-word tokens and suffixes in Devanagari script.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and sub-syllable linguistic components.
These tokens represent common sub-word fragments, characters, and vowel signs characteristic of the Devanagari script used in Hindi and Marathi.
This feature vector is related to common sub-word tokens and inflectional suffixes in the Hindi language.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens and character fragments from the Hindi script (Devanagari).
This vector is related to Hindi and Devanagari vowel characters and their initial combinations.
